title: Marriage Registration (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE MARRIAGE REGISTRATION ORDINANCE.

body.heading: Short title.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Marriage Registration (Amendment) Act.

body.heading: Retrospective effect. [ 49 (2), 11 of 1963.]
body.raw_text: 5. The amendments made in the Marriage Registration Ordinance by section 49 (1) of Act No. 11 of 1963 shall come into operation on the first day of January, 1964.
